contexts.text: They are (then) left solitary, and sit in torment.
Being expelled from societies, they sit solitary.
To sit by one's self = a solitary state such as is that of the thought in grief and despair.
Solitary () = those not infested by evils and falsities. AE 376:10. AE 483:13.
Angels who dwell solitary... HH 189. SE 5181.
Some who load a solitary life hear Spirits speaking to them, without danger...
They who have given themselves to a life almost solitary... in the other life are sad, and despise others. HH 535.
There is no solitary good, nor solitary truth. Explained.
There is no solitary charity, nor solitary faith.
They wander solitary, and are thus kept in bonds.
They sit solitary, solely in a Society of the solitary...
They sit solitary, and are devastated.
Those in a general idea, which yet is determinate... are they who have been solitary, and have thought much...
They think in the Sensuous, (as do some also) when speaking to themselves, as solitaries do.
When (the celestial) are by themselves, and as it were solitary, they think from the objects before their sight.
(The Jews) appear solitary. SE 5619:2.
When they live solitary, house by house. SE 5513:23.
They become Genii... partly from a solitary life in itself, that is, from the delight of it.
Those also are serpents who in the world have lived solitary...
Nor a solitary one in thine assemblies () = that not one truth shall be left among the Knowledges.
They live solitary in deserts...
By the impurities of their minds they defile the pieties of their lips, especially if... they live solitary.
They dwell solitary in huts, or caves.
Huts in which they dwell solitary with some harlot.
